scope: 12 parent contact sheets, all 48 requests in RAW/BASE_POST/CLEAN_FINAL_POST; selected full-resolution pages additionally inspected
method: Each contact sheet keeps both A/new camera views and both original fixed section planes. No source-style ranking or adoption success count is assigned.
